goal: Identify meiotic crossovers by evaluating the three intervals in trio_dev_data/focused/candidates.tsv. Use trio reads and VCF genotypes to build evidence for each listed candidate ID, and specify an IGV view.
criteria: Use the trio reads and IGV views to assess whether the child switches between the two haplotypes of the same parent across each interval. Mark unresolved calls uncertain and continue.
distill: Use the reviews to propose one testable way to improve crossover detection.
